draft.title: Accent the downbeat from the harmony's bar position, by dimming the rest of the bar
draft.context: With live beat detection every pulse lands on a beat, but the app doesn't know which beat starts the bar, so all four pulse the same. The change in harmony from beat to beat shows the bar position in about 3 of 5 songs; the bass never does. So the accent may only show while the harmony gives a consistent position. Otherwise, and whenever beats-per-pulse > 1, the beat comes from Spotify or reactive is off, the show must stay exactly as it is today.
draft.decision:
Find the bar position in the beat tracker, apply it at render time.
- `OnsetDetector` adds a 12-bin chroma per hop (bins 300 Hz–4 kHz, folded to pitch class) to `Onset`.
- New pure `beat.Downbeat`, stepped by `BeatTracker` next to `Groove` and restarted on every new lock the same way. It averages chroma per beat, scores each beat's change as 1 − cosine against the previous beat, and at each groove bar line casts the bar's vote: the beat slot (0–3) whose change beats the others by `Margin`, or none.
- From the last 8 votes: off→on at slot s when ≥7 of 8 are s; on at s→t when the last 4 are all t; off after 8 bars in a row where s doesn't hold ≥3 of the last 4. So one odd bar never switches the accent off or moves it.
- The result is a `BarAccent(slot, before, fromBeat)` carried on `AudioReading`. `fromBeat` is the next beat count on the new bar line (≡ new slot mod 4, or ≡ old slot when switching off). Each beat at or after `fromBeat` uses `slot` and each before uses `before`, so changes only land at a bar line, even with `audio.offset-ms` moving the render ahead of capture.
- `Effects` scales the peak boost, never the rest level, colour or white. Rhythm lights: every sixteenth except the first of beat `slot` is scaled by (1 − strength), through a `Pulse.rhythm` overload taking a per-(beat, sixteenth) peak factor. Pulse lights: `Effects.pulseLight` scales the peak of every pulse not on beat `slot`. The colour branch isn't touched. `Effects.forPulsesOf(bpp)` drops the accent unless bpp = 1.
- The rhythm lights' bar is not moved. Slot s maps to sixteenth 4·s of the groove bar, and the kick pattern is not rotated.
draft.components: Capture → `OnsetDetector.step` (chroma) → `BeatTracker.step` → `Downbeat.at` → `AudioReading.accent` → `SyncEngine.followAudio` (logs accent news) → `playingFrame` → `Effects.at(…).forPulsesOf(bpp)` → `pulseFrame`. Inside `pulseFrame`, the Rhythm branch goes to `Effects.rhythmLight` → `Pulse.rhythm` (overload with peak factor) and the Pulse branch goes to `Effects.pulseLight`. Config: `ReactiveSettings.downbeatAccent` → `LightShowConfig.problems`. The UI adds a slider to `Sections.rhythmAndPulse`. Calls only go downstream, and `Downbeat`, `BarAccent`, `Pulse` and `Effects` stay pure.
draft.contracts:
All additive, each with a default that gives today's behaviour:
- Config key `light-show.reactive.downbeat-accent` (Double, 0–1, default 0.3), added to `reference.conf`.
- `ReactiveSettings.downbeatAccent` in `model` (shared JVM/JS). Settings JSON gets field `reactive.downbeatAccent`, and `ConfigSnippet` gets the `reactive.downbeat-accent` path automatically.
- `Onset.chroma: Vector[Double] = Vector.empty`.
- `AudioReading.accent: BarAccent = BarAccent.Off`.
- `BeatTracker.downbeat: Option[Downbeat] = None`.
- `Effects.accent: BarAccent = BarAccent.Off` and `Effects.accentStrength: Double = 0.0`.
- New `Pulse.rhythm` overload, `Effects.pulseLight`, `Effects.forPulsesOf` and `SyncEngine.accentNews`.
No env variables or HTTP endpoints change.
draft.failureModes:
- Config: a value out of range adds "reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1" to `LightShowConfig.problems`. At startup this is fatal through the pureconfig `CannotConvert`. On the settings page it's recoverable: `LiveSettings.update` returns the `Left`, and the show keeps its old settings.
- Analysis: there is no I/O. Silence (empty chroma), an unchanging harmony, a change on every beat and random votes all mean no vote, so the accent stays or goes off. A lost beat drops `downbeat` and a new lock restarts it.
- The audio stream failing is handled as today: the reading is cleared, so `accent` is gone too.
No new sealed error type: the only failure is validation, which uses the existing list of problems.
draft.config: `reactive.downbeat-accent = 0.3` in `reference.conf`, with the comment "Dims every rhythm hit but beat one's first sixteenth, and pulses on beats 2–4, once the harmony shows where the bar starts; only with beats-per-pulse 1. 0 is off". Checked in `LightShowConfig.problems` as `0 ≤ v ≤ 1`, with NaN rejected via `!(v >= 0 && v <= 1)`. The UI slider runs from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05.
draft.observability:
INFO from `followAudio` via `SyncEngine.accentNews`, logged only when the accent changes:
- "Downbeat accent on beat {n} of the bar": `accent_beat`, `from_beat`.
- "Downbeat accent moved from beat {a} to beat {b}": `previous_beat`, `accent_beat`, `from_beat`.
- "Downbeat accent off: no consistent bar position": `previous_beat`, `from_beat`.
Beats are numbered 1–4 on the tracker's bar. Nothing is logged per frame.
alternatives: Bar position from the bass or kick: the analysis showed it is never consistent (out of scope).
Boosting beat one: no headroom once the peak is capped at full brightness, and ruled out by the issue.
Rotating the groove so its bar starts on beat one: out of scope, and it would disturb the calm/learnt pattern.

package domain.config

import domain.engine.LightRole
import io.circe.Codec

/**
 * How the show reacts to live audio, beyond the beat.
 *
 * Each light gets a job from `roles`, repeated across the zone in channel order. Rhythm lights pulse with the bar's
 * kick pattern, calmed by `rhythm`. Colour lights swell with `colourSwell`, once every couple of beats, and move up to `colourReach` palette
 * colours along the palette as the music goes higher or lower. Pulse lights do the classic travelling pulse, their palette turning by up to `colourShift`
 * degrees as the treble picks up or drops away.
 *
 * Brightness follows the music's energy, between `quietest` and `loudest` times normal. A big hit (louder than
 * anything in the last few seconds by `hitRatio`) flashes every light towards white by `flash`, fading over
 * `flashDecayMs`; a treble onset (`sparkleRatio` times the usual background) twinkles one light that isn't a rhythm
 * light by `sparkle`, fading over `sparkleDecayMs`.
 *
 * Once the harmony shows where the bar starts, `downbeatAccent` scales down the peak of every rhythm hit but the first
 * sixteenth of beat one, and of the pulses on beats two to four; only when every beat pulses. 0 switches it off.
 */
case class ReactiveSettings(
  enabled: Boolean = true,
  quietest: Double = 0.35,
  loudest: Double = 1.6,
  colourShift: Double = 25.0,
  flash: Double = 0.7,
  flashDecayMs: Long = 200,
  hitRatio: Double = 1.15,
  sparkle: Double = 0.6,
  sparkleDecayMs: Long = 100,
  sparkleRatio: Double = 4.0,
  roles: List[LightRole] = List(LightRole.Rhythm, LightRole.Colour),
  colourReach: Double = 1.0,
  colourSwell: SwellSettings = SwellSettings(),
  rhythm: RhythmSettings = RhythmSettings(),
  downbeatAccent: Double = 0.3
) derives Codec.AsObject

package domain.config

import domain.engine.PaletteType
import io.circe.Codec

/**
 * The light show's settings. `area` is the entertainment area to play on, by name; without one, the app uses
 * `hue.zone-id`, or the bridge's only music area. `albumCoverColours` builds each song's palette from its album cover's
 * colour rather than a random one.
 */
case class LightShowConfig(
  palette: PaletteType = PaletteType.Analogous,
  beatSource: BeatSource = BeatSource.Spotify,
  audio: AudioSettings = AudioSettings(),
  reactive: ReactiveSettings = ReactiveSettings(),
  defaultBpm: Double = 20.0,
  beatsPerPulse: Double = 1.0,
  syncOffsetMs: Long = -150,
  frameIntervalMs: Long = 16,
  pulse: PulseSettings = PulseSettings(),
  pause: PauseSettings = PauseSettings(),
  area: Option[String] = None,
  albumCoverColours: Boolean = true
) derives Codec.AsObject

object LightShowConfig {

  /** Everything that can't work in these settings, each naming the setting as the config file does; empty if none. */
  def problems(c: LightShowConfig): List[String] = {
    val p = c.pulse
    val swell = c.reactive.colourSwell
    val r = c.reactive.rhythm
    List(
      Option.when(c.area.exists(_.trim.isEmpty))("area can't be empty"),
      Option.when(c.defaultBpm <= 0)("default-bpm must be positive"),
      Option.when(c.beatsPerPulse <= 0)("beats-per-pulse must be positive"),
      Option.when(c.frameIntervalMs <= 0)("frame-interval-ms must be positive"),
      Option.when(p.attack < 0 || p.sustain < 0)("pulse.attack and pulse.sustain can't be negative"),
      Option.when(p.attack + p.sustain >= 1)("pulse.attack + pulse.sustain must be less than 1"),
      Option.when(p.decayCurve <= 0)("pulse.decay-curve must be positive"),
      Option.when(p.restLevel < 0 || p.peakBoost < 0)("pulse.rest-level and pulse.peak-boost can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.pause.fadeOutMs < 0)("pause.fade-out-ms can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.audio.minBpm <= 0 || c.audio.maxBpm <= c.audio.minBpm)("audio.min-bpm must be positive and below audio.max-bpm"),
      Option.when(c.audio.device.trim.isEmpty)("audio.device can't be empty"),
      Option.when(c.audio.holdSeconds < 0)("audio.hold-seconds can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.quietest <= 0 || c.reactive.loudest < c.reactive.quietest)(
        "reactive.quietest must be positive and no more than reactive.loudest"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.flash < 0 || c.reactive.flash > 1 || c.reactive.sparkle < 0 || c.reactive.sparkle > 1)(
        "reactive.flash and reactive.sparkle must be between 0 and 1"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.flashDecayMs <= 0 || c.reactive.sparkleDecayMs <= 0)(
        "reactive.flash-decay-ms and reactive.sparkle-decay-ms must be positive"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.hitRatio <= 1 || c.reactive.sparkleRatio <= 1)("reactive.hit-ratio and reactive.sparkle-ratio must be above 1"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.roles.isEmpty)("reactive.roles needs at least one role"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.colourReach < 0)("reactive.colour-reach can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.colourSwell.beats <= 0)("reactive.colour-swell.beats must be positive"),
      Option.when(swell.attack < 0 || swell.sustain < 0)("reactive.colour-swell.attack and reactive.colour-swell.sustain can't be negative"),
      Option.when(swell.attack + swell.sustain >= 1)("reactive.colour-swell.attack + reactive.colour-swell.sustain must be less than 1"),
      Option.when(swell.decayCurve <= 0)("reactive.colour-swell.decay-curve must be positive"),
      Option.when(swell.restLevel < 0 || swell.peakBoost < 0)(
        "reactive.colour-swell.rest-level and reactive.colour-swell.peak-boost can't be negative"
      ),
      Option.when(!(r.minGapMs >= 0 && r.minGapMs <= 400))("reactive.rhythm.min-gap-ms must be between 0 and 400"),
      Option.when(!(r.threshold >= 0 && r.threshold <= 0.9))("reactive.rhythm.threshold must be between 0 and 0.9"),
      Option.when(!(r.smoothing >= 0 && r.smoothing <= 0.9))("reactive.rhythm.smoothing must be between 0 and 0.9"),
      Option.when(!(c.reactive.downbeatAccent >= 0 && c.reactive.downbeatAccent <= 1))("reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1")
    ).flatten
  }

  def validate(c: LightShowConfig): Either[String, LightShowConfig] =
    problems(c) match {
      case Nil => Right(c)
      case found => Left(found.mkString("; "))
    }
}

package beat

/**
 * What one hop of audio sounded like.
 *
 * `flux` is the onset strength the beat tracker uses (low end weighted most), `bassFlux` the same for the low end
 * alone (kick and bass), `trebleFlux` for the high end alone (hi-hats, cymbals, consonants), and `rms` the hop's
 * loudness. `kick` is how much the power in the kick drum's range (about 40-130 Hz) rose since the previous window:
 * unlike the flux, it isn't compressed, so the big low thump of a kick stands out from the bass line around it.
 * `pitch` is where the sound in the middle of the spectrum (vocals, leads, chords) is centred, in octaves above 1 Hz,
 * or None when that range is silent. `chroma` is how loud each of the twelve pitch classes is in that range, from C,
 * summing to 1, or empty when it's silent.
 */
case class Onset(
  flux: Double,
  bassFlux: Double,
  trebleFlux: Double,
  rms: Double,
  kick: Double,
  pitch: Option[Double],
  chroma: Vector[Double] = Vector.empty
)

package beat

/**
 * What the music is doing right now.
 *
 * `energy` and `treble` compare the last fraction of a second with the track's usual level, so 1.0 means typical,
 * below 1 quieter or duller, above 1 louder or brighter. `hit` is the latest big hit (a crash or a drop), `sparkle`
 * the latest treble onset (hi-hats, cymbals), and `sparkles` counts them, so each can land on a different light.
 * `pitch` is how high the vocals, leads and chords sit compared with usual for the track, from -1 (well below) to 1
 * (well above). `groove` is the pattern the rhythm lights play (see [[Groove.lights]]), empty without a beat. `news` is what the latest hop has to say about how the tempo was chosen.
 * `rhythmEnergy` is `energy` smoothed from bar to bar for the rhythm lights; without it they follow `energy`.
 * `accent` is the beat the harmony says starts the bar (see [[Downbeat]]), off without a beat.
 */
case class AudioReading(
  beat: Option[BeatState],
  energy: Double = 1.0,
  treble: Double = 1.0,
  hit: Option[Hit] = None,
  sparkle: Option[Hit] = None,
  sparkles: Long = 0,
  pitch: Double = 0.0,
  groove: Vector[Double] = Vector.empty,
  news: Vector[TempoNews] = Vector.empty,
  rhythmEnergy: Option[Double] = None,
  accent: BarAccent = BarAccent.Off
)

package ui

import domain.config.{AudioSettings, BeatSource, LightShowConfig, PulseSettings, ReactiveSettings, RhythmSettings, SwellSettings}
import domain.engine.LightRole

/** Every setting on the page, grouped as it's shown. */
object Sections {

  private type Change = (LightShowConfig, Double) => LightShowConfig

  private def pulse(change: (PulseSettings, Double) => PulseSettings): Change =
    (c, v) => c.copy(pulse = change(c.pulse, v))

  private def swell(change: (SwellSettings, Double) => SwellSettings): Change =
    (c, v) => c.copy(reactive = c.reactive.copy(colourSwell = change(c.reactive.colourSwell, v)))

  private def rhythm(change: (RhythmSettings, Double) => RhythmSettings): Change =
    (c, v) => c.copy(reactive = c.reactive.copy(rhythm = change(c.reactive.rhythm, v)))

  private def reactive(change: (ReactiveSettings, Double) => ReactiveSettings): Change =
    (c, v) => c.copy(reactive = change(c.reactive, v))

  private def audio(change: (AudioSettings, Double) => AudioSettings): Change =
    (c, v) => c.copy(audio = change(c.audio, v))

  private def millis(v: Double): Long = math.round(v)

  /**
   * The roles the lights actually have: the role pattern while the show reacts to live audio, otherwise the classic
   * pulse on every light.
   */
  def rolesPlaying(c: LightShowConfig): Set[LightRole] =
    if (reacting(c)) c.reactive.roles.toSet else Set(LightRole.Pulse)

  private def reacting(c: LightShowConfig): Boolean = c.reactive.enabled && c.beatSource == BeatSource.Audio

  /** Unused, with `reason`, while no light plays any of `roles`. */
  private def unlessPlaying(roles: Set[LightRole], reason: String): LightShowConfig => Option[String] =
    c => Option.when(rolesPlaying(c).intersect(roles).isEmpty)(s"$reason, so these change nothing right now.")

  val area: Section = Section(
    title = "Entertainment area",
    intro = "Where the show plays. The bridge plays one area at a time; when the show moves, the old area's lights go back to how they were.",
    controls = List(Control.Area),
    sliders = Nil
  )

  val roles: Section = Section(
    title = "Light roles",
    intro = "What each light does. The pattern repeats across your lights in channel order. The sections below say which lights they change.",
    controls = List(Control.Roles, Control.Reactions),
    sliders = Nil
  )

  val rhythmAndPulse: Section = Section(
    title = "Rhythm and pulse lights",
    intro = "The shape of each pulse on the rhythm and pulse lights.",
    controls = Nil,
    sliders = List(
      Slider(
        key = "beats-per-pulse",
        label = "Beats per pulse",
        help = "Pulse once every this many beats. Rhythm lights follow the kick pattern instead once there's a live beat.",
        min = 0.5, max = 4, step = 0.5,
        get = _.beatsPerPulse,
        set = (c, v) => c.copy(beatsPerPulse = v)
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.attack",
        label = "Rise",
        help = "Fraction of a pulse spent rising.",
        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.01,
        get = _.pulse.attack,
        set = pulse((p, v) => p.copy(attack = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.sustain",
        label = "Hold",
        help = "Fraction of a pulse spent at full brightness.",
        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.01,
        get = _.pulse.sustain,
        set = pulse((p, v) => p.copy(sustain = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.decay-curve",
        label = "Fade curve",
        help = "Shape of the fade after the peak; higher fades faster.",
        min = 0.5, max = 5, step = 0.1,
        get = _.pulse.decayCurve,
        set = pulse((p, v) => p.copy(decayCurve = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.rest-level",
        label = "Rest brightness",
        help = "Brightness between pulses, as a multiple of the colour's own.",
        min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.01,
        get = _.pulse.restLevel,
        set = pulse((p, v) => p.copy(restLevel = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.peak-boost",
        label = "Peak boost",
        help = "How much the peak adds on top of the rest brightness.",
        min = 0, max = 4, step = 0.05,
        get = _.pulse.peakBoost,
        set = pulse((p, v) => p.copy(peakBoost = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.rhythm.min-gap-ms",
        label = "Minimum gap (ms)",
        help = "Kicks closer together than this merge into one pulse. 0 switches it off.",
        min = 0, max = 400, step = 10,
        get = _.reactive.rhythm.minGapMs.toDouble,
        set = rhythm((r, v) => r.copy(minGapMs = millis(v)))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.rhythm.threshold",
        label = "Weak-hit threshold",
        help = "How far a kick must stand out from the bar's usual to light; higher drops more weak hits. 0 switches it off.",
        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.05,
        get = _.reactive.rhythm.threshold,
        set = rhythm((r, v) => r.copy(threshold = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.rhythm.smoothing",

        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.05,
        get = _.reactive.rhythm.smoothing,
        set = rhythm((r, v) => r.copy(smoothing = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.downbeat-accent",
        label = "Downbeat accent",

        min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.05,
        get = _.reactive.downbeatAccent,
        set = reactive((r, v) => r.copy(downbeatAccent = v))
      )
    ),
    unused = unlessPlaying(Set(LightRole.Rhythm, LightRole.Pulse), "No light is a rhythm or pulse light")
  )

  val pulseLights: Section = Section(
    title = "Pulse lights",
    intro = "The classic pulse, travelling across the zone.",
    controls = Nil,
    sliders = List(
      Slider(
        key = "pulse.stagger",
        label = "Wave stagger",

  val colourLights: Section = Section(
    title = "Colour lights",

    controls = Nil,
    sliders = List(

      ),
      Slider(

        help = "Fraction of the swell spent rising.",
        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.01,
        get = _.reactive.colourSwell.attack,
        set = swell((s, v) => s.copy(attack = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.colour-swell.sustain",
        label = "Hold",
        help = "Fraction of the swell spent at the peak.",
        min = 0, max = 0.9, step = 0.01,
        get = _.reactive.colourSwell.sustain,
        set = swell((s, v) => s.copy(sustain = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.colour-swell.decay-curve",

  )

  val sparkles: Section = Section(
    title = "Sparkles: colour and pulse lights",
    intro = "A hi-hat twinkles one colour or pulse light towards white.",
    controls = Nil,
    sliders = List(
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.sparkle",
        label = "Sparkle",
        help = "How far a hi-hat twinkles a light towards white.",

        set = reactive((r, v) => r.copy(sparkle = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.sparkle-decay-ms",
        label = "Sparkle fade (ms)",
        help = "How fast a sparkle fades.",
        min = 20, max = 500, step = 10,
        get = _.reactive.sparkleDecayMs.toDouble,
        set = reactive((r, v) => r.copy(sparkleDecayMs = millis(v)))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.sparkle-ratio",
        label = "Sparkle threshold",
        help = "How far above the usual treble counts as a sparkle.",
        min = 1.5, max = 10, step = 0.5,
        get = _.reactive.sparkleRatio,
        set = reactive((r, v) => r.copy(sparkleRatio = v))
      )
    ),
    unused = c =>
      if (!reacting(c)) Some("The show isn't reacting to the music, so these change nothing right now.")
      else unlessPlaying(Set(LightRole.Colour, LightRole.Pulse), "No light is a colour or pulse light")(c)
  )

  val allLights: Section = Section(
    title = "All lights",
    intro = "How brightness and flashes follow the music, the colours each song gets, and what the lights do while nothing plays.",
    controls = List(Control.Palette, Control.AlbumCoverColours, Control.SongPalette, Control.RestingColour),
    sliders = List(
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.quietest",
        label = "Quietest",
        help = "Brightness in the quietest passages, as a multiple of normal.",
        min = 0.05, max = 1, step = 0.05,
        get = _.reactive.quietest,
        set = reactive((r, v) => r.copy(quietest = v))
      ),
      Slider(
        key = "reactive.loudest",
        label = "Loudest",
        help = "Brightness in the loudest passages, as a multiple of normal.",

slices.delivers: Chroma per hop, the Downbeat search, BarAccent on the reading, dimming in Effects and Pulse, gating by beats-per-pulse, the reactive.downbeat-accent setting (config, validation, UI slider), accent log lines, and the four docs/how-it-works.md passages, in one PR.
acceptanceCriteria: On generated drums with a harmony that changes every four beats, once about 8 bars have played, the pulse lights peak brighter on the bar's first beat than on the other three, and the rhythm lights' hit on the first sixteenth is brighter than every other hit in the bar, off-beat sixteenths included.

With the accent on, beat one (the first sixteenth for rhythm lights) peaks the same as at strength 0, every other rhythm hit and every pulse on beats 2–4 peaks lower, and rest brightness, hue and saturation match strength 0.
On the same audio the accent doesn't show before about 8 bars.
With a harmony that changes every beat, never changes, or changes at random bar positions, every pulse and rhythm hit matches strength 0.
Once on, a single bar that breaks the pattern (a fill, a bar of 2) doesn't switch the accent off or move it.
When the harmony's bar position shifts and stays, the accent moves after about 4 bars, not after 1.
When the harmony stops showing a consistent position, the accent switches off once 8 bars have passed with none.
The accent switches on, off and moves only at a bar line.
After the tracker locks again, the accent is off until a position has been consistent for about 8 bars.

At strength 0, the output for any audio is identical to today's. At strength 1 with the accent on, every rhythm hit but beat one's first sixteenth, and every pulse on beats 2–4, peaks at rest brightness, while beat one peaks at today's peak.
With beats-per-pulse above 1, with Spotify timing, or with reactive off, the output is identical to today's at any strength. Colour lights are unchanged at any strength.
Without the setting the app uses 0.3. Below 0 or above 1, the app refuses to start and reports "reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1".

findings.headline: Pulse lights can't tell which beat of the bar they're on from the count they're given
findings.ifIgnored: Pulse lights would accent a beat that changes with every tempo re-estimate, not beat one.
findings.problem: In `playingFrame`, `pulses` is `b.beatsAt(heardAt) / beatsPerPulse`, which counts beats since the latest estimate's `beatAt`. That estimate is redone a few times a second, so the whole part of the count keeps resetting. `BarAccent.at`/`fromBeat` count beats since lock (`countAt`). The proposed `pulseLight(lag, pulses, settings)` only receives `pulses`, so it has no way to place a pulse in the tracker's bar. The only count since lock in `Effects` is `rhythm.beats`, and the design never says pulse lights should use it.
findings.suggestion: Say that the pulse lights find their beat from the count since lock (`rhythm.beats - lag`, or a new `beats` field on Effects), and keep `pulses` only for the envelope phase. Add a unit test where `beatAt`/`number` move between frames while the bar position stays the same.

findings.headline: At strength 1, beat one's fading glow keeps the next rhythm hits above rest
findings.ifIgnored: Criterion 12 can't pass for the off-beat sixteenths of beat one, or its test gets bent until it does.
findings.problem: `Pulse.rhythm` takes the max over every sixteenth's envelope, and each envelope lasts a whole beat (`phase < 1` in beats). Beat one's first-sixteenth pulse isn't dimmed, so its decaying tail is still above zero at the peaks of sixteenths 2–4 of beat one. Scaling those sixteenths' own pulses to 0 leaves the light at max(0, tail), which is above rest brightness. Criterion 12 says every rhythm hit other than beat one's first sixteenth peaks at rest brightness. The design's property ('non-accented peaks equal rest') would fail on real output.
findings.suggestion: Decide how criterion 12 is met. Either define a hit's peak as that sixteenth's own scaled contribution and test that, or clip the accented pulse's tail at the next sixteenth that has a groove weight. Then write the PulseSpec/RhythmLightsSpec assertion to match, and check the rule against criterion 3 (beat one's peak unchanged).

findings.headline: Accent can switch on or off partway into a bar because the render runs ahead of capture
findings.ifIgnored: With the default 100 ms audio offset, an accent on beat one starts or stops after the bar has begun, which criterion 9 forbids.
findings.problem: The vote is cast when capture crosses a groove bar line at beat 4k. The render sits at `countAt(monotonic + offsetMs)`, about 100 ms later by default. `fromBeat` is described as 'the next beat count on the new bar line (≡ slot mod 4)'. For slot 0 that is either 4k, which the render has already passed, so the change lands mid-bar, or 4k+4. The design doesn't say which, and the claim that this works 'even with audio.offset-ms' only holds if `fromBeat` is strictly after the render's position. Offsets of a beat or more at fast tempos make it worse.
findings.suggestion: Define `fromBeat` as the first beat ≡ slot (mod 4) that is strictly after the capture count plus the offset in beats (or simply ≥ 4k+4 when slot is 0, provided offsets stay under a bar). Add a SyncEngineRunSpec/TestControl case with a non-zero `audio.offset-ms` that checks the first dimmed or undimmed frame falls on a bar line.

findings.headline: The FFT can't tell pitch classes apart below about 700 Hz
findings.ifIgnored: Generated test chords may pass while real songs rarely show a consistent bar position, so the accent seldom switches on.
findings.problem: The detector uses a 1024-sample window at 44.1 kHz, so each bin is about 43 Hz wide. A semitone is about 18 Hz wide at 300 Hz and doesn't reach 43 Hz until about 725 Hz. Folding the bins from 300 to 700 Hz to a pitch class by bin centre puts most of the energy of chord roots and thirds in the wrong class. The chroma then mostly reflects upper harmonics, not the harmony that the earlier 3-of-5 analysis measured. Synthetic tones that are pure or sit high will hide this.
findings.suggestion: Spread each bin's energy across the pitch classes it covers, or start the chroma range at about 700 Hz, or compute chroma from a longer window or by summing several hops per beat. Note that the test fixtures should put chord tones in the 150–500 Hz range, so the tests reflect real music.

findings.headline: Accent switches off after 9 bars without a pattern, not the 8 the criterion says
findings.ifIgnored: Tests get written to the design's rule, so the 8-bar criterion is never checked literally.
findings.problem: 'Off after 8 bars in a row where s doesn't hold ≥3 of the last 4' only starts counting at the second bar without a pattern, because one odd bar still leaves 3 of 4 votes on s. So the accent switches off at the 9th bar line. Criterion 8 says 'once 8 bars have passed with no consistent position', and unlike the others it doesn't say 'about'.
findings.suggestion: Either count from the first bar that fails to vote s (keeping a single odd bar harmless by resetting the count when s comes back), or set `OffBars` to 7 and state the exact switch-off bar in DownbeatSpec.

findings.headline: A chord on every beat that repeats each bar would switch the accent on
findings.ifIgnored: The 'changes every beat' test passes or fails depending on which chords the fixture happens to use.
findings.section: Slices: tests for 'harmony changes every beat'
findings.problem: `vote` takes the slot with the biggest change by `Margin`. If the generated track cycles four chords per bar, one transition (for example the last chord back to the first) can consistently differ from the others by more than 0.1 in cosine distance. That gives a steady vote and switches the accent on, against criterion 5.
findings.suggestion: Specify the fixture: alternate two chords that are equally far apart, or use transitions of equal cosine distance. Add a DownbeatSpec case showing that equal-magnitude changes on every beat give no vote.

findings.headline: Planned docs wording says the accent 'lifts' beat one, but it actually dims the rest
findings.ifIgnored: The docs would describe boosting, which the issue rules out, and mislead users about why beat one isn't brighter at full peak.
findings.problem: The slice says the light-roles section will say the accent 'lifts the rhythm lights' first-sixteenth hit and the pulse lights' beat-one pulse'. The mechanism keeps beat one at today's peak and dims everything else.
findings.suggestion: Word the light-roles section as 'accents … by dimming the rest of the bar', in line with the pulse section.

draft.title: Accent the downbeat from the harmony's bar position, by dimming the rest of the bar
draft.context: With live beat detection every pulse lands on a beat, but the app doesn't know which beat starts the bar, so all four beats pulse the same. The change in harmony from beat to beat shows the bar position in about 3 of 5 songs, and the bass never does. So the accent may only show while the harmony gives a consistent position. The rest of the time the show must stay exactly as it is today, and the same goes for beats-per-pulse above 1, Spotify timing and reactive off.
draft.decision:
Find the bar position in the tracker and apply it when rendering.
- **Chroma.** `OnsetDetector` keeps the last 4096 samples (bins about 11 Hz apart) and takes a 12-bin chroma from 140 Hz to 2 kHz. Each bin's power is spread over the pitch classes its band covers, in proportion to the overlap in log frequency, so roots and thirds below 700 Hz go to the right class.
- **Votes.** The new pure `beat.Downbeat` is stepped by `BeatTracker` alongside `Groove` and restarted on every new lock. It averages chroma per beat and scores each beat's change as 1 − cosine against the previous beat. At each groove bar line the bar votes for the slot (0–3) whose change is ≥ `MinChange` and beats the next biggest by `Margin`. A partial bar, equal changes or no change give no vote.
- **Rules.** The accent switches **on** at s when the window holds 8 votes and at least 7 are s. It **moves** to t when the last 4 votes are all t. For **off**, a run starts at the first bar that doesn't vote s, at that bar's beat ≡ s (`missed`). The run ends when a bar votes s and s holds at least 3 of the last 4 votes, so one odd bar is harmless. The accent goes off at exactly `missed + 4·8`, so it's dark once 8 bars have passed. That is decided at the last bar line before it lands, and once decided it's final.
- **Landing at a bar line.** The lights run `lead` = `audio.offset-ms` beats ahead of capture, through the new `TrackerSettings.leadMs`. On and move land on the first beat ≡ the new slot strictly after `count + lead`. A change waiting to land blocks any new decision. `BarAccent(slot, before, fromBeat)` gives `before` for beats before `fromBeat` and `slot` from it on.
- **Pulse lights** take their beat from the count since lock: `b = floor(rhythm.beats − lag + attack)`. `pulses` is used only for the envelope phase, because the whole part of `beatsAt` restarts with each estimate. When b is the downbeat or the accent is off, the level is unscaled. Otherwise it's scaled by 1 − strength, so beats 2–4 at strength 1 sit at rest.
- **Rhythm lights** use `Pulse.accentFactor`, which scales the whole rhythm envelope. It's 1 nearer a downbeat's first sixteenth than any other sixteenth with groove weight > 0 (the groove repeats bar on bar), or when the accent is off at `floor(beats)`. Elsewhere it's 1 − strength, with ties dimmed. So beat one peaks exactly at today's level, which covers criterion 3, and every other hit peaks at (1 − strength) × today's, its tail included, which gives rest at strength 1 (criterion 12). The cost is a step down halfway to the next hit.
- Only the level is scaled, never the rest level, the colour or the white. `Effects.forPulsesOf(bpp)` drops the accent unless bpp = 1. The colour branch is untouched, and the groove is not rotated: slot s is sixteenth 4·s of the groove bar.
draft.components: Capture → `OnsetDetector.step` (chroma) → `BeatTracker.step` (lead from `TrackerSettings.leadMs`) → `Downbeat.at` → `AudioReading.accent` → `SyncEngine.followAudio` (`accentNews`) → `playingFrame` → `Effects.at(…).forPulsesOf(bpp)` → `pulseFrame`. In `pulseFrame`, Pulse lights go to `Effects.pulseLight` (→ `Pulse.pulseAt`, `BarAccent.pulsePeak`) and Rhythm lights go to `Effects.rhythmLight` (→ `Pulse.rhythm` overload → `Pulse.accentFactor`). Config flows `ReactiveSettings.downbeatAccent` → `LightShowConfig.problems`, and `AudioSettings.offsetMs` → `TrackerSettings.from` → `leadMs`. The UI adds a slider to `Sections.rhythmAndPulse`. Calls only go downstream. `Downbeat`, `BarAccent`, `Pulse` and `Effects` stay pure.
draft.contracts:
All additive, each defaulting to today's behaviour:
- Config key `light-show.reactive.downbeat-accent` (Double, 0–1, default 0.3) in `reference.conf`.
- `ReactiveSettings.downbeatAccent` in `model` (shared JVM/JS). Settings JSON gains the field `reactive.downbeatAccent`, and `ConfigSnippet` gets the path `reactive.downbeat-accent` automatically.
- `Onset.chroma = Vector.empty`, `OnsetDetector.chromaHistory = Vector.empty`, `TrackerSettings.leadMs = 0`, `BeatTracker.downbeat = None`, `AudioReading.accent = BarAccent.Off`, and `Effects.accent = Off` with `Effects.accentStrength = 0.0`.
- New: the `Pulse.rhythm` overload, `Pulse.accentFactor`, `Pulse.pulseAt`, `Effects.pulseLight`, `Effects.forPulsesOf` and `SyncEngine.accentNews`.
No environment variables or HTTP endpoints change.
draft.failureModes:
- **Config:** a value out of range or NaN adds "reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1" to `LightShowConfig.problems`. At startup that's fatal through the existing pureconfig `CannotConvert`. On the settings page it's recoverable: `LiveSettings.update` returns `Left` and the old settings stay.
- **Analysis:** there's no I/O. Silence gives empty chroma, which casts no vote. A grid jump leaves a partial bar, which casts no vote. Losing the beat drops `downbeat` (accent off), and a new lock restarts the search.
- **A lead of more than a bar** (very large `audio.offset-ms`): changes still land on a bar line of the new slot, just later.
- **Audio stream failure:** as today, the reading is cleared and the accent goes with it.
There's no new sealed error type, because the only failure is validation, which uses the existing list of problems.
draft.config: `reactive.downbeat-accent = 0.3` in `reference.conf`, with the comment "Once the harmony shows where the bar starts, dims every rhythm hit but the bar's first sixteenth, and the pulses on beats 2–4, by this much; only with beats-per-pulse 1. 0 is off". `LightShowConfig.problems` checks it as `!(v >= 0 && v <= 1)`. The UI slider runs from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05. `TrackerSettings.from` copies `audio.offset-ms` into `leadMs` and needs no new validation.
draft.observability:
INFO from `followAudio` via `SyncEngine.accentNews`, logged only when the target slot changes, with beats numbered 1–4 on the tracker's bar:
- "Downbeat accent on beat {n} of the bar", with fields `accent_beat` and `from_beat`.
- "Downbeat accent moved from beat {a} to beat {b}", with fields `previous_beat`, `accent_beat` and `from_beat`.
- "Downbeat accent off", with fields `previous_beat` and `from_beat` (a lost or new lock logs this too).
Nothing is logged per frame or per vote.
alternatives: Finding the bar from the bass or kick: the analysis showed it's never consistent, and it's out of scope.
Chroma from the 1024-sample window: bins of 43 Hz put roots and thirds below 700 Hz in the wrong pitch class. Starting the range at 700 Hz would drop them altogether.

Dimming each sixteenth's own pulse only, and leaving beat one's tail: at strength 1 the tail keeps the next hits above rest (criterion 12), and at lower strengths it can hide the dimming (criterion 3).

package domain.config

import domain.engine.LightRole
import io.circe.Codec

/**
 * How the show reacts to live audio, beyond the beat.
 *
 * Each light gets a job from `roles`, repeated across the zone in channel order. Rhythm lights pulse with the bar's
 * kick pattern, calmed by `rhythm`. Colour lights swell with `colourSwell`, once every couple of beats, and move up to `colourReach` palette
 * colours along the palette as the music goes higher or lower. Pulse lights do the classic travelling pulse, their palette turning by up to `colourShift`
 * degrees as the treble picks up or drops away.
 *
 * Brightness follows the music's energy, between `quietest` and `loudest` times normal. A big hit (louder than
 * anything in the last few seconds by `hitRatio`) flashes every light towards white by `flash`, fading over
 * `flashDecayMs`; a treble onset (`sparkleRatio` times the usual background) twinkles one light that isn't a rhythm
 * light by `sparkle`, fading over `sparkleDecayMs`.
 *
 * Once the harmony shows where the bar starts, `downbeatAccent` scales down the peak of every rhythm hit but the bar's
 * first sixteenth, and of the pulses on beats two to four; only when every beat pulses. 0 switches it off.
 */
case class ReactiveSettings(
  enabled: Boolean = true,
  quietest: Double = 0.35,
  loudest: Double = 1.6,
  colourShift: Double = 25.0,
  flash: Double = 0.7,
  flashDecayMs: Long = 200,
  hitRatio: Double = 1.15,
  sparkle: Double = 0.6,
  sparkleDecayMs: Long = 100,
  sparkleRatio: Double = 4.0,
  roles: List[LightRole] = List(LightRole.Rhythm, LightRole.Colour),
  colourReach: Double = 1.0,
  colourSwell: SwellSettings = SwellSettings(),
  rhythm: RhythmSettings = RhythmSettings(),
  downbeatAccent: Double = 0.3
) derives Codec.AsObject

package domain.config

import domain.engine.PaletteType
import io.circe.Codec

/**
 * The light show's settings. `area` is the entertainment area to play on, by name; without one, the app uses
 * `hue.zone-id`, or the bridge's only music area. `albumCoverColours` builds each song's palette from its album cover's
 * colour rather than a random one.
 */
case class LightShowConfig(
  palette: PaletteType = PaletteType.Analogous,
  beatSource: BeatSource = BeatSource.Spotify,
  audio: AudioSettings = AudioSettings(),
  reactive: ReactiveSettings = ReactiveSettings(),
  defaultBpm: Double = 20.0,
  beatsPerPulse: Double = 1.0,
  syncOffsetMs: Long = -150,
  frameIntervalMs: Long = 16,
  pulse: PulseSettings = PulseSettings(),
  pause: PauseSettings = PauseSettings(),
  area: Option[String] = None,
  albumCoverColours: Boolean = true
) derives Codec.AsObject

object LightShowConfig {

  /** Everything that can't work in these settings, each naming the setting as the config file does; empty if none. */
  def problems(c: LightShowConfig): List[String] = {
    val p = c.pulse
    val swell = c.reactive.colourSwell
    val r = c.reactive.rhythm
    List(
      Option.when(c.area.exists(_.trim.isEmpty))("area can't be empty"),
      Option.when(c.defaultBpm <= 0)("default-bpm must be positive"),
      Option.when(c.beatsPerPulse <= 0)("beats-per-pulse must be positive"),
      Option.when(c.frameIntervalMs <= 0)("frame-interval-ms must be positive"),
      Option.when(p.attack < 0 || p.sustain < 0)("pulse.attack and pulse.sustain can't be negative"),
      Option.when(p.attack + p.sustain >= 1)("pulse.attack + pulse.sustain must be less than 1"),
      Option.when(p.decayCurve <= 0)("pulse.decay-curve must be positive"),
      Option.when(p.restLevel < 0 || p.peakBoost < 0)("pulse.rest-level and pulse.peak-boost can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.pause.fadeOutMs < 0)("pause.fade-out-ms can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.audio.minBpm <= 0 || c.audio.maxBpm <= c.audio.minBpm)("audio.min-bpm must be positive and below audio.max-bpm"),
      Option.when(c.audio.device.trim.isEmpty)("audio.device can't be empty"),
      Option.when(c.audio.holdSeconds < 0)("audio.hold-seconds can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.quietest <= 0 || c.reactive.loudest < c.reactive.quietest)(
        "reactive.quietest must be positive and no more than reactive.loudest"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.flash < 0 || c.reactive.flash > 1 || c.reactive.sparkle < 0 || c.reactive.sparkle > 1)(
        "reactive.flash and reactive.sparkle must be between 0 and 1"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.flashDecayMs <= 0 || c.reactive.sparkleDecayMs <= 0)(
        "reactive.flash-decay-ms and reactive.sparkle-decay-ms must be positive"
      ),
      Option.when(c.reactive.hitRatio <= 1 || c.reactive.sparkleRatio <= 1)("reactive.hit-ratio and reactive.sparkle-ratio must be above 1"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.roles.isEmpty)("reactive.roles needs at least one role"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.colourReach < 0)("reactive.colour-reach can't be negative"),
      Option.when(c.reactive.colourSwell.beats <= 0)("reactive.colour-swell.beats must be positive"),
      Option.when(swell.attack < 0 || swell.sustain < 0)("reactive.colour-swell.attack and reactive.colour-swell.sustain can't be negative"),
      Option.when(swell.attack + swell.sustain >= 1)("reactive.colour-swell.attack + reactive.colour-swell.sustain must be less than 1"),
      Option.when(swell.decayCurve <= 0)("reactive.colour-swell.decay-curve must be positive"),
      Option.when(swell.restLevel < 0 || swell.peakBoost < 0)(
        "reactive.colour-swell.rest-level and reactive.colour-swell.peak-boost can't be negative"
      ),
      Option.when(!(r.minGapMs >= 0 && r.minGapMs <= 400))("reactive.rhythm.min-gap-ms must be between 0 and 400"),
      Option.when(!(r.threshold >= 0 && r.threshold <= 0.9))("reactive.rhythm.threshold must be between 0 and 0.9"),
      Option.when(!(r.smoothing >= 0 && r.smoothing <= 0.9))("reactive.rhythm.smoothing must be between 0 and 0.9"),
      Option.when(!(c.reactive.downbeatAccent >= 0 && c.reactive.downbeatAccent <= 1))("reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1")
    ).flatten
  }

  def validate(c: LightShowConfig): Either[String, LightShowConfig] =
    problems(c) match {
      case Nil => Right(c)
      case found => Left(found.mkString("; "))
    }
}

package beat

import domain.config.{LightShowConfig, RhythmSettings}
import scala.concurrent.duration.*

/** `leadMs` is how far ahead of what's heard the lights play (`audio.offset-ms`), so bar-line changes land ahead of them. */
case class TrackerSettings(
  sampleRate: Double = 44100,
  hop: Int = 512,
  window: Int = 1024,
  historySeconds: Double = 8.0,
  minBpm: Double = 60,
  maxBpm: Double = 180,
  reestimateEvery: Int = 22,
  silenceRms: Double = 0.002,
  minConfidence: Double = 2.5,
  keepConfidence: Double = 1.2,
  steadySeconds: Double = 3.0,
  phaseSwitch: Double = 0.6,
  phaseMemorySeconds: Double = 10.0,
  holdSeconds: Double = 10.0,
  hitRatio: Double = 1.15,
  sparkleRatio: Double = 4.0,
  rhythm: RhythmSettings = RhythmSettings(),
  leadMs: Long = 0
) {
  val frameRate: Double = sampleRate / hop
  val hopDuration: FiniteDuration = (hop / sampleRate).seconds.toNanos.nanos
  val capacity: Int = (historySeconds * frameRate).toInt
  val minFrames: Int = (4.0 * frameRate).toInt
  val hitWindow: Int = (4.0 * frameRate).toInt
  val sparkleWindow: Int = (2.0 * frameRate).toInt
  val steadyEstimates: Int = math.max(1, (steadySeconds * frameRate / reestimateEvery).round.toInt)

  /** Smoothing factor of an exponential average with the given time constant, per hop. */
  def smoothing(seconds: Double): Double = 1 - math.exp(-(hop / sampleRate) / seconds)
}

object TrackerSettings {

  /** The tracker's tuning, from the light show's settings. */
  def from(show: LightShowConfig): TrackerSettings =
    TrackerSettings(
      minBpm = show.audio.minBpm,
      maxBpm = show.audio.maxBpm,
      holdSeconds = show.audio.holdSeconds,
      hitRatio = show.reactive.hitRatio,
      sparkleRatio = show.reactive.sparkleRatio,
      rhythm = show.reactive.rhythm,
      leadMs = show.audio.offsetMs
    )
}

package beat

/**
 * What one hop of audio sounded like.
 *
 * `flux` is the onset strength the beat tracker uses (low end weighted most), `bassFlux` the same for the low end
 * alone (kick and bass), `trebleFlux` for the high end alone (hi-hats, cymbals, consonants), and `rms` the hop's
 * loudness. `kick` is how much the power in the kick drum's range (about 40-130 Hz) rose since the previous window:
 * unlike the flux, it isn't compressed, so the big low thump of a kick stands out from the bass line around it.
 * `pitch` is where the sound in the middle of the spectrum (vocals, leads, chords) is centred, in octaves above 1 Hz,
 * or None when that range is silent. `chroma` is how loud each of the twelve pitch classes is where chords sit
 * (see [[OnsetDetector.chroma]]), from C, summing to 1, or empty when it's silent.
 */
case class Onset(
  flux: Double,
  bassFlux: Double,
  trebleFlux: Double,
  rms: Double,
  kick: Double,
  pitch: Option[Double],
  chroma: Vector[Double] = Vector.empty
)

package beat

/**
 * What the music is doing right now.
 *
 * `energy` and `treble` compare the last fraction of a second with the track's usual level, so 1.0 means typical,
 * below 1 quieter or duller, above 1 louder or brighter. `hit` is the latest big hit (a crash or a drop), `sparkle`
 * the latest treble onset (hi-hats, cymbals), and `sparkles` counts them, so each can land on a different light.
 * `pitch` is how high the vocals, leads and chords sit compared with usual for the track, from -1 (well below) to 1
 * (well above). `groove` is the pattern the rhythm lights play (see [[Groove.lights]]), empty without a beat. `news` is what the latest hop has to say about how the tempo was chosen.
 * `rhythmEnergy` is `energy` smoothed from bar to bar for the rhythm lights; without it they follow `energy`.
 * `accent` is the beat the harmony says starts the bar (see [[Downbeat]]), off without a beat.
 */
case class AudioReading(
  beat: Option[BeatState],
  energy: Double = 1.0,
  treble: Double = 1.0,
  hit: Option[Hit] = None,
  sparkle: Option[Hit] = None,
  sparkles: Long = 0,
  pitch: Double = 0.0,
  groove: Vector[Double] = Vector.empty,
  news: Vector[TempoNews] = Vector.empty,
  rhythmEnergy: Option[Double] = None,
  accent: BarAccent = BarAccent.Off
)

package ui

import domain.config.{AudioSettings, BeatSource, LightShowConfig, PulseSettings, ReactiveSettings, RhythmSettings, SwellSettings}

slices.title: Accent the downbeat on rhythm and pulse lights from the harmony's bar position
slices.delivers: In one PR: the chroma from a longer window, the Downbeat search with exact on, move and off rules, BarAccent landing on a bar line ahead of the lights, pulse lights placed by the count since lock, the rhythm envelope dimmed outside the downbeat's cell, the beats-per-pulse gate, the reactive.downbeat-accent setting (config, validation, slider), the accent log lines, and the four docs/how-it-works.md passages.
acceptanceCriteria: On generated drums with chord tones between 150 and 500 Hz changing every four beats, once about 8 bars have played, the pulse lights peak brighter on the bar's first beat than on the other three. On the same audio, the rhythm lights' hit on the first sixteenth is brighter than every other hit in the bar, off-beat sixteenths included.

With the accent on, beat one (the first sixteenth for rhythm lights) peaks exactly as at strength 0. Every other rhythm hit and every pulse on beats 2–4 peaks lower, and rest brightness, hue and saturation match strength 0.
The accent doesn't show before the 8th bar line after the lock.

With chords changing every beat (alternating two chords with no shared notes), never changing, or changing at shuffled bar positions (no position more than 3 times in any 8 bars), every pulse and rhythm hit matches strength 0.
Once the accent is on, a single bar that breaks the pattern (a fill, or a bar of 2) doesn't switch it off or move it.
When the harmony's position moves to another beat and stays there, the accent moves after 4 bars, not after 1.
When the harmony stops showing a position, the accent is off from the bar line 8 bars after the first bar that missed it.
Every switch on, move and switch off lands on a bar line of the slot it lands on, at the default and at a 250 ms audio.offset-ms.
After the tracker loses the beat and locks again, the accent is off until a position has held for about 8 bars.
Pulse lights accent the same beat while the beat estimate's beatAt and number move between frames and the count since lock stays the same.

At strength 0 the output for any audio is identical to today's. At strength 1 with the accent on, every rhythm hit but the bar's first sixteenth, and every pulse on beats 2–4, peaks at rest brightness, while beat one peaks at today's peak.
With beats-per-pulse above 1, with Spotify timing, or with reactive off, the output is identical to today's at any strength. Colour lights are unchanged at any strength.
Without the setting the app uses 0.3. Below 0, above 1 or NaN, the app refuses to start and reports "reactive.downbeat-accent must be between 0 and 1".
The settings page shows "Downbeat accent" in Rhythm and pulse lights, and changing it there changes the show.

docs/how-it-works.md, light-roles section: the downbeat accent accents the rhythm lights' hit on the bar's first sixteenth and the pulse lights' pulse on beat one by dimming the rest of the bar, and leaves the colour lights alone.

docs/how-it-works.md, pulse section: the accent dims every other rhythm hit in the bar and the pulses on beats 2–4. It switches on after about 8 bars with one consistent position, moves after 4 bars at a new position, ignores a single odd bar, and switches off once 8 bars have passed without a consistent position. Changes always land on a bar line, and a new lock starts it again with the accent off.
docs/how-it-works.md config table: reactive.downbeat-accent, range 0 to 1, default 0.3.
docs/how-it-works.md beats-per-pulse note: with beats-per-pulse above 1 the show is unchanged by the accent.
